# UAT: P504 — Auto-Generated Banners for Stories, Points & Profiles

## Prerequisites
- At least one story with a banner (auto-generated or pre-seeded)
- At least one story without a banner (gradient fallback)
- At least one point with a banner
- At least one point without a banner
- A profile with a banner
- A profile without a banner (fresh or banner removed)
- Two user accounts (owner + non-owner)

---

## UAT-1: Story banner display

### UAT-1.1: Story with banner shows image
**Given:** A story has a `banner_url` set
**When:** Visiting the story detail page
**Then:** The banner image displays at the top of the page, full-width, with `object-cover` fit at h-48 (mobile) / h-64 (desktop)
**Verify:** Visual inspection in browser, check img src matches the stored URL

### UAT-1.2: Story without banner shows gradient fallback
**Given:** A story has no `banner_url` (null)
**When:** Visiting the story detail page
**Then:** A soft radial gradient displays in the banner area using the author's avatar color
**Verify:** Visual inspection; no broken image icon; gradient is visible

### UAT-1.3: Story banner alt text
**Given:** A story banner image is displayed
**When:** Inspecting the image element
**Then:** The `alt` attribute contains the story title
**Verify:** DevTools inspection or screen reader

---

## UAT-2: Story banner controls (author)

### UAT-2.1: Author sees controls
**Given:** Logged in as the story author
**When:** Viewing their own story detail page with a banner
**Then:** "New banner" and "Remove banner" pill buttons visible at bottom-right of the banner area
**Verify:** Visual inspection

### UAT-2.2: Non-author does NOT see controls
**Given:** Logged in as a different user (not the author)
**When:** Viewing someone else's story detail page
**Then:** Banner displays but NO "New banner" or "Remove banner" buttons visible
**Verify:** Visual inspection

### UAT-2.3: Anonymous does NOT see controls
**Given:** Not logged in
**When:** Viewing a story detail page
**Then:** Banner displays but NO control buttons visible
**Verify:** Visual inspection

### UAT-2.4: Remove banner works
**Given:** Logged in as author, story has a banner
**When:** Clicking "Remove banner"
**Then:** Banner image disappears immediately, gradient fallback shows. "Remove banner" button disappears (only "New banner" remains).
**Verify:** Visual check + DB query: `banner_url` is null

### UAT-2.5: Regenerate banner works
**Given:** Logged in as author
**When:** Clicking "New banner"
**Then:** Spinner shows on button, new banner appears after generation completes
**Verify:** Visual check + new image src differs from previous

### UAT-2.6: Regenerate after remove
**Given:** Logged in as author, banner was removed (gradient showing)
**When:** Clicking "New banner"
**Then:** New banner generates and displays
**Verify:** Banner image appears where gradient was

---

## UAT-3: Point banner display

### UAT-3.1: Point with banner shows image
**Given:** A point has a `banner_url` set
**When:** Visiting the point detail page
**Then:** The banner image displays at the top, same sizing as story banners
**Verify:** Visual inspection

### UAT-3.2: Point without banner shows gradient fallback
**Given:** A point has no `banner_url`
**When:** Visiting the point detail page
**Then:** A gradient fallback displays (blue-100 based per spec)
**Verify:** Visual inspection

### UAT-3.3: NO controls on points for anyone
**Given:** A point with a banner
**When:** Visiting as the point creator, as another user, or as anonymous
**Then:** NO "New banner" or "Remove banner" buttons visible for anyone
**Verify:** Visual inspection in all three auth states

### UAT-3.4: Point banner alt text
**Given:** A point banner image is displayed
**When:** Inspecting the image element
**Then:** The `alt` attribute contains the point statement (truncated to 100 chars if long)
**Verify:** DevTools inspection

---

## UAT-4: Profile banner display

### UAT-4.1: Profile with banner shows image
**Given:** A profile has a `banner_url` set
**When:** Visiting the profile page `/p/:slug`
**Then:** The banner image displays above the profile info, full-width within the content container
**Verify:** Visual inspection

### UAT-4.2: Profile without banner shows gradient fallback
**Given:** A profile has no `banner_url`
**When:** Visiting the profile page
**Then:** A gradient fallback displays using the profile's avatar color
**Verify:** Visual inspection

### UAT-4.3: LinkedIn-style avatar overlap
**Given:** A profile page with a banner (image or gradient)
**When:** Viewing the profile page
**Then:** The avatar (large, ~64px) is anchored at the bottom-left of the banner, overlapping the banner edge. White ring/border around avatar for separation.
**Verify:** Visual inspection, compare with LinkedIn profile layout reference

### UAT-4.4: Profile banner alt text
**Given:** A profile banner image is displayed
**When:** Inspecting the image element
**Then:** The `alt` attribute contains "{Name}'s profile banner"
**Verify:** DevTools inspection

---

## UAT-5: Profile banner controls (owner)

### UAT-5.1: Owner sees controls
**Given:** Logged in and viewing own profile
**When:** Profile has a banner
**Then:** "New banner" and "Remove banner" pill buttons visible at bottom-right of the banner area
**Verify:** Visual inspection

### UAT-5.2: Non-owner does NOT see controls
**Given:** Logged in as a different user
**When:** Viewing someone else's profile
**Then:** Banner displays but NO control buttons visible
**Verify:** Visual inspection

### UAT-5.3: Remove banner on profile works
**Given:** Logged in as profile owner, profile has a banner
**When:** Clicking "Remove banner"
**Then:** Banner image disappears, gradient fallback shows
**Verify:** Visual check + DB query

### UAT-5.4: Regenerate banner on profile works
**Given:** Logged in as profile owner
**When:** Clicking "New banner"
**Then:** New banner generates and displays
**Verify:** New image appears

## UAT-6: Auto-generation on creation

### UAT-6.1: New story gets auto-generated banner
**Given:** Logged in user
**When:** Creating a new story
**Then:** After creation, revisiting the story detail page shows a generated banner (may take a few seconds — fire-and-forget)
**Verify:** Create story, wait 5-10s, reload detail page — banner visible

### UAT-6.2: New point gets auto-generated banner
**Given:** Logged in user
**When:** Creating a new point
**Then:** After creation, revisiting the point detail page shows a generated banner
**Verify:** Create point, wait 5-10s, reload detail page — banner visible

### UAT-6.3: Failed generation does not block creation
**Given:** Gemini is temporarily unavailable (or rate limited)
**When:** Creating a story or point
**Then:** Story/point is created successfully. Gradient fallback shows. No error shown to user.
**Verify:** Create content while rate limited — content saves, no error toast

---

## UAT-7: Profile lazy generation

### UAT-7.1: Existing profile gets banner on first visit
**Given:** An existing profile with `banner_url = null` and `banner_generation_attempted = false`
**When:** Any authenticated user visits the profile page
**Then:** Banner generation fires in the background. On subsequent visits, banner appears.
**Verify:** Visit profile, wait 10s, reload — banner visible. `banner_generation_attempted` = true in DB.

### UAT-7.2: No repeated generation on failure
**Given:** A profile where generation was attempted but failed (`banner_url = null`, `banner_generation_attempted = true`)
**When:** Visiting the profile again
**Then:** No generation attempt fires. Gradient fallback displays.
**Verify:** Check network tab — no calls to `generate-banner` edge function

---

## UAT-8: Social sharing previews (OG images)

### UAT-8.1: Story OG image uses banner
**Given:** A story has a `banner_url`
**When:** Pasting the story URL into LinkedIn/Twitter/Telegram preview tool
**Then:** The preview card shows the generated banner as the OG image
**Verify:** Use a link preview tool (e.g., opengraph.xyz) or paste into Telegram

### UAT-8.2: Point OG image uses banner
**Given:** A point has a `banner_url`
**When:** Pasting the point URL into a preview tool
**Then:** The preview card shows the generated banner
**Verify:** Same as above

### UAT-8.3: Profile OG image uses banner
**Given:** A profile has a `banner_url`
**When:** Pasting the profile URL into a preview tool
**Then:** The preview card shows the profile banner
**Verify:** Same as above

### UAT-8.4: Fallback OG image when no banner
**Given:** A story/point/profile with no `banner_url`
**When:** Pasting the URL into a preview tool
**Then:** The default ClarityPledge icon shows (existing behavior preserved)
**Verify:** Check og:image tag returns the default image

---

## UAT-9: Edge cases

### UAT-9.1: Rate limit handling
**Given:** A user triggers banner generation repeatedly (5+ times in 5 minutes)
**When:** Clicking "New banner" after limit is hit
**Then:** Toast appears: "Too many requests — try again in a minute." Button becomes disabled.
**Verify:** Click regenerate 6 times quickly, observe toast

### UAT-9.2: Banner 404 fallback
**Given:** A story/point/profile has a `banner_url` that returns 404 (stale URL)
**When:** Visiting the detail page
**Then:** Gradient fallback displays (no broken image icon). Owner can click "New banner" to regenerate.
**Verify:** Set banner_url to an invalid URL, visit page — gradient shows cleanly

### UAT-9.3: /live page has NO banners
**Given:** Any state
**When:** Visiting the /live page
**Then:** No banner areas visible on the live session page
**Verify:** Visual inspection of /live

### UAT-9.4: Feed cards have NO banners
**Given:** Stories/points with banners
**When:** Viewing the feed page
**Then:** Feed cards do NOT display banner images (banners are detail page + profile only)
**Verify:** Visual inspection of /feed

---

## UAT-10: Accessibility

### UAT-10.1: Keyboard navigation of controls
**Given:** Logged in as story author, story detail page
**When:** Using Tab key to navigate
**Then:** "New banner" and "Remove banner" buttons are reachable via Tab, activated by Enter/Space
**Verify:** Keyboard-only navigation test

### UAT-10.2: Screen reader announcements
**Given:** Banner area on story detail page
**When:** Using a screen reader (VoiceOver)
**Then:** Banner image reads its alt text (story title). Gradient fallback reads "Decorative banner."
**Verify:** VoiceOver test

### UAT-10.3: Loading state announced
**Given:** Clicking "New banner" while logged in as author
**When:** Generation is in progress
**Then:** Screen reader announces loading state (aria-busy)
**Verify:** VoiceOver test during generation
